clue.text: Vehicle from Italy is Russian

parts.note: I is the international vehicle registration letter for Italy
a van is a goods vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a car imported from Italy is now Russian-owned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Russian' is a noun here: a typical Russian man's name stands for any Russian, as 'Ivan' was the stock name for a Russian soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: The commonest Russian first name serves as a nickname for a Russian man, much as Tommy does for a British soldier.

clue.text: At home, rattle on about the illiberal

parts.note: someone at home is said to be in

indicators.note: about here means the letters are moved around and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone sits at home ranting on about narrow-minded people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning' but signals the rearrangement of 'rattle on'; 'the' is a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Illiberal people are narrow-minded and unwilling to accept views that differ from their own.

clue.text: A maple to climb? It's a palm tree!

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Acer is the botanical genus of the maples

explanation.surface: A joke about trying to climb a maple and finding it is actually a palm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to climb' reverses the maple's Latin name upwards, as suits a down clue. The areca is the betel-nut palm.
explanation.definitionFit: The areca is a genus of tropical palms, one of which yields the betel nut.

clue.text: Pierce safe, somehow, to rescue apparatus

indicators.note: somehow means the letters are put together in some new way

explanation.surface: A safe-cracker plans to break into a safe, then needs escape gear.
explanation.definitionFit: An iron stairway or ladder on a building's outside is equipment for getting people out when a blaze breaks out.

clue.text: Speculates it's the latest underwear

parts.note: whatever is the latest fashion is said to be in
vests are undershirts in British English

explanation.surface: A fashion note announcing that the newest trend is in undergarments.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a vest is an undershirt, not a waistcoat.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who speculates puts money into a venture hoping for a profit.

clue.text: Web-cast about manly upbringing of favourite member of the flock

indicators.note: about means the shuffled letters go round the other piece
cast here means thrown about, so the letters are shuffled
upbringing, read as bringing up, says the word is turned to read upwards in a down clue

parts.note: manly can mean male in character

explanation.surface: An online broadcast discusses how to raise a boy to be manly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' shuffles the letters of 'Web' (EWB); 'upbringing of' turns the manly word up (ELAM); 'about' wraps the first round the second. The definition recalls the poor man's cherished ewe lamb in Nathan's parable.
explanation.definitionFit: In the biblical parable the poor man's single young female sheep was his treasured pet, the dearest animal in the fold.

clue.text: Fit to do the plumbing?

explanation.surface: A question whether someone is fit enough to work as a plumber.
explanation.walkthrough: To plumb a lake is to measure its depth with a weighted line, so plumbing here has nothing to do with pipes.
explanation.definitionFit: A sound body is healthy and fit, and to sound water is to measure its depth with a line, which is plumbing it.

clue.text: Tree that primate finds problematic?

parts.note: read whimsically, a tree that baffles an ape or monkey is one that sets that animal a puzzle, which is the tree's common name

explanation.surface: A primate, perhaps an archbishop, is stumped by some tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primate' suggests a church leader, but it is a monkey; the tree is the monkey puzzle, said to be too spiky for monkeys to climb.
explanation.definitionFit: The Chilean pine, a spiky conifer, is popularly called the monkey puzzle because monkeys supposedly could not climb it.

clue.text: Going to and fro — still in existence

indicators.note: going in either direction gives the same letters, so the word reads alike forwards and backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Something that goes back and forth is still around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'still in' is a link; 'esse' is the Latin for 'to be', used in English in the phrase in esse, actually existing.
explanation.definitionFit: Philosophers use the Latin infinitive for being as a noun meaning actual being or reality.

clue.text: Diplomatic with our clans abroad

indicators.note: abroad can mean scattered widely, so the letters are spread and reordered

explanation.surface: A note that diplomatic dealings concern our Scottish clans living overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Consuls are diplomatic officials posted abroad, so matters of their office are diplomatic.

clue.text: Article on window-fitting in art gallery

parts.note: the definite article is the word the
a louvre is a set of angled slats fitted in a window or vent

explanation.surface: A piece of writing about a window being installed in an art gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' and 'in' are only link words here, not positional signals.
explanation.definitionFit: The great Paris museum, once a royal palace, houses the Mona Lisa and is perhaps the world's best-known gallery.

clue.text: Thirty across also includes this mountain area

indicators.note: includes means the wanted letters are held inside the run, so the outer letters drop away

parts.note: the answer to 30 across, the clue 'Excursion heading for old city', is tour

explanation.surface: A travel note saying that a tour also takes in a mountain region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'includes' says the answer sits inside TOUR ALSO: drop the first T and last O and URALS is left.
explanation.definitionFit: The range dividing Europe from Asia, in Russia, gives its name to the surrounding mountainous region.

clue.text: A great many things to be carried

explanation.surface: A remark that there is a great deal of baggage to carry.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally lots means a large number, and the burdens a lorry or pack animal bears are its cargo.

clue.text: Fruit served initially with fish

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word served

parts.note: a haddock is a North Atlantic food fish

explanation.surface: A menu note about fruit being brought out as a starter with fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The shaddock, also called pomelo, is a large citrus fruit related to the grapefruit.

clue.text: It's a job to get the better of such a hard boss

parts.note: a task is a piece of work, a job
to master someone is to overcome or defeat them

explanation.surface: Getting the upper hand over a tough employer is quite a job.
explanation.definitionFit: A strict overseer who demands heavy work from others is a harsh supervisor.

clue.text: Bad scare over lord lieutenant's orders to withdraw

indicators.note: over means the jumbled letters cover the other piece, going round it
bad here means spoiled or out of order, so the letters are reordered

parts.note: LL is the abbreviation for Lord Lieutenant, the monarch's representative in a British county

explanation.surface: A county official issues orders to retreat after a nasty fright.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bad' rearranges 'scare' into RECAS; 'over' wraps those letters round the abbreviation. A Lord Lieutenant is the Crown's representative in a British county.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambassador's or product's withdrawal is ordered by summonses to come back.

clue.text: Yowling noise misdirected at a curlew

indicators.note: misdirected means sent the wrong way, so the letters go out of order

explanation.surface: A screeching sound aimed at a wading bird by mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: A cat's wailing at night, the shrill howl of a tom on the prowl, is the classic yowl.

clue.text: Girl has a rib broken touring mountainous state

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the jumbled letters surround the name
broken means the letters are smashed and reassembled

parts.note: Ava is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A woman with a fractured rib goes on a trip around an Alpine region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' rearranges A RIB into BARIA; 'touring' puts BARIA round AVA.
explanation.definitionFit: The large southern German Land, home of Munich, includes the Bavarian Alps.

clue.text: Drive east if diversion can be confirmed

indicators.note: a diversion sends traffic a different route, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A motorist is told to drive eastwards if a road diversion can be confirmed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something verified has been checked and shown to be true.

clue.text: This plant the ultimate reason, the rhymster said, for visit by Spanish princess

definitions.text: This plant the ultimate reason, the rhymster said, for visit by Spanish princess

parts.words: This plant the ultimate reason, the rhymster said, for visit by Spanish princess
parts.note: alludes to the nursery rhyme in which the King of Spain's daughter comes to call, all for the sake of the singer's little tree bearing a silver nutmeg and golden pear

explanation.surface: A plant that, in an old rhyme, drew a royal Spanish visitor.
explanation.walkthrough: The English nursery rhyme 'I had a little nut tree' ends with the King of Spain's daughter visiting 'all for the sake of my little nut tree'.
explanation.definitionFit: In the rhyme the princess calls purely because of the singer's tree bearing a nutmeg and a pear.

clue.text: Authorize gold we receive is from English politician

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament

indicators.note: receive means one piece takes the other inside it

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: An English MP is said to authorise gold for us.
explanation.walkthrough: 'receive' puts the plural pronoun inside the heraldic word for gold, giving OWER; 'is from' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To empower someone is to give them the authority or power to act.

clue.text: Not a suitable berth for vessel carrying fish!

definitions.text: Not a suitable berth for vessel carrying fish!

indicators.note: carrying means the vessel takes the fish ahead of it

parts.note: a carp is a freshwater fish
an ark is a vessel, as in Noah's

explanation.surface: A joke that a boat laden with fish cannot be moored in a parking area.
explanation.walkthrough: A vessel carrying fish would be a CARP ARK; the whole clue jokes that such a boat could hardly berth in a CAR PARK.
explanation.definitionFit: A parking area is meant for motor vehicles, so it is no place to moor a boat.

clue.text: Whip a huge amount from the plant

parts.note: the cat, short for cat-o'-nine-tails, is a whip
a mint is a large sum of money

explanation.surface: Someone whips up a fortune from a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a mint' means a fortune, as in 'it cost a mint'.
explanation.definitionFit: Nepeta is an aromatic herb of the mint family that cats find intoxicating.

clue.text: Combination of two drugs cause of his eccentric behaviour?

definitions.text: Combination of two drugs cause of his eccentric behaviour?

parts.note: crack is a form of cocaine
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: A man's odd behaviour is blamed on mixing two narcotics.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: a man whose eccentric conduct comes from crack plus pot is a crank.
explanation.definitionFit: A crank or eccentric person behaves in a wildly odd way, the kind of conduct the clue describes.

clue.text: Dead bird lying ahead of mob

indicators.note: lying ahead of means the bird comes before the other letter

parts.note: a crow is a bird

explanation.surface: A dead bird lies in front of a gathering of people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lying ahead of' puts CROW in front of D.
explanation.definitionFit: A mob is a large throng of people, a multitude.

clue.text: Girl growing flowers

explanation.surface: A young woman who raises flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: Flora is a girl's name, and also the plant life of a region.
explanation.definitionFit: Flora is a woman's name, and the word also means the plants growing in a place.

clue.text: Old books, in the past collected here in new Zealand?

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, the older books of the Bible
ago means in the past

explanation.surface: Old books collected long ago in a newly settled country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collected' is a link; the definition is a place. OTAGO is a region of New Zealand's South Island, home to Dunedin.
explanation.definitionFit: The province in the south of New Zealand's South Island is a place in that country.

clue.text: Book performers in a show

explanation.surface: A book about the performers in a stage show.
explanation.walkthrough: The Book is the Acts of the Apostles in the New Testament.
explanation.definitionFit: Acts of the Apostles is a New Testament book, and variety turns or performing artists on a bill are acts.

clue.text: Church fuss following Japanese tea ceremony

indicators.note: following means the second piece comes after the first

parts.note: ado is fuss or bother

explanation.surface: A church causes a fuss after a Japanese tea ritual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following' looks like it might signal reversed order, but here it simply means the fuss comes after the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Chado, the way of tea, is the Japanese name for the formal ritual of preparing and serving green tea.

clue.text: Coloured lure secures this fish

parts.note: white is a colour
bait is a lure

explanation.surface: A brightly coloured lure is used to catch fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'secures' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Whitebait are the tiny young of herring and sprats, eaten fried whole.

clue.text: Team spirit is adroitly brought about

indicators.note: brought about can mean turned round, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Team spirit is cleverly fostered.
explanation.definitionFit: Solidarity is unity and mutual support among a group.

clue.text: Excursion heading for old city

parts.note: heading for means going to
Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A trip bound for an ancient city.
explanation.walkthrough: Ur is the ancient Sumerian city in modern Iraq, a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: A tour is a trip or outing.
